lines.cap: Your muscles don't grow in the gym. They grow while you sleep.
lines.say: Your muscles don't grow in the gym. They grow while you sleep.

lines.cap: Every heavy rep rips thousands of tiny fibres inside the muscle.
lines.say: Every heavy rep rips thousands of tiny fibres inside the muscle.

lines.cap: Micro tears. That soreness the next day? That's damage, not growth.
lines.say: Micro tears. That soreness the next day? That's damage, not growth.

lines.cap: Growth starts when you're asleep. Deep sleep is when your body releases most of its growth hormone.
lines.say: Growth starts when you're asleep. Deep sleep is when your body releases most of its growth hormone.

lines.cap: Then protein gets sent to every tear, and each fibre is rebuilt a little thicker than before.
lines.say: Then protein gets sent to every tear, and each fibre is rebuilt a little thicker than before.

lines.cap: In one study, dieters who slept five and a half hours lost sixty percent more muscle than those who slept eight and a half.
lines.say: In one study, dieters who slept five and a half hours lost sixty percent more muscle than those who slept eight and a half.

lines.cap: So train hard, eat your protein, and protect your sleep. Seven to nine hours.
lines.say: So train hard, eat your protein, and protect your sleep. Seven to nine hours.
